title: Chicken Fajitas
author: Claude
description: Spiced chicken strips with charred peppers and onion, wrapped in warm tortillas.
steps: Toss the chicken with the cumin, paprika, a pinch of salt and half the lime juice.
Char the peppers and onion in the oil in a very hot pan for 5 minutes and set aside.
Cook the chicken in the same pan for 5–6 minutes until cooked through, then return the vegetables.
Warm the tortillas, squeeze over the rest of the lime and serve with yogurt and cheddar.
